items.author: who owns the context
items.text:
The Birds Take Priority
••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••
This year’s nest (up in the rafters)
Must have blown a hole last night
For the little blighters were stuck
In the walls this morning

It was the middle hole
From which we fished them out

coverage: 6 posts, September–November 2026. Compiled Tuesday, Nov. 17, ET.
